The entire route definition lives in a single file. Here is the complete breakdown:

**File:** `/Users/lxy/Documents/GitHub/LinXueyuanStdio/viben/apps/desktop/src/App.tsx`

No separate `routes.tsx` or `router.tsx` file exists. All routes are defined directly in `App.tsx` using `BrowserRouter` + `Routes`.

---

## Route Hierarchy

The routing has two branches depending on `isMobile()`:

---

### Mobile Branch (`isMobile() === true`)

```
/m                          <MobileLayout>
  /m/connect                  <ConnectPage>
  /m/devices                  <DeviceListPage>
  /m/chat                     <MobileChatPage>
  /m (index)                  → Navigate to /m/connect
*                           → Navigate to /m/connect
```

---

### Desktop Branch (`isMobile() === false`)

All routes under `/` are wrapped in `<AppLayout>`, except for two standalone routes at the end.

```
/                           <AppLayout>
  / (index)                   <HomeRedirect>

  /mcp-services               <McpServicesLayout>
    /mcp-services (index)       → Navigate to dashboard
    /mcp-services/dashboard     <DashboardPage>
    /mcp-services/data-sources  <ProvidersPage>
    /mcp-services/search-service <SearchServicePage>
    /mcp-services/page-debug    <PageDebugPage>
    /mcp-services/logs          <LogsPage>

  /os                         <OsPage>
  /inspector                  <InspectorPage>
  /mcp-marketplace            <MarketplacePage>  (lazy)
  /skills-market              <SkillsMarketPage> (lazy)
  /chat-monitor               <ChatMonitorPage>
  /devices/pair               <DevicePairPage>
  /documents                  <DocumentsPage>

  /settings                   <SettingsPage>
    /settings (index)           null
    /settings/general           null
    /settings/account           null
    /settings/shortcuts         null
    /settings/notifications     null
    /settings/gateway           null
    /settings/channels          null
    /settings/executors         null
    /settings/model             null
    /settings/agents            null
    /settings/mcp               null
    /settings/skills            null
    /settings/sandbox           null
    /settings/environment       null
    /settings/terminalFonts     null
    /settings/overlay           null
    /settings/voice             null
    /settings/storage           null
    /settings/developer         null
    /settings/about             null

  /about                      <AboutPage>

  -- Detail pages (query params for workspace context) --
  /agent/:agentId             <AgentDetailPage>
  /executor/:executorType     <ExecutorDetailPage>
  /skill/:skillId             <SkillDetailPage>
  /mcp-server/:serverName     <McpServerDetailPage>
  /subagent/:configId         <SubAgentDetailPage>
  /prompt/:promptId           <PromptDetailPage>
  /command/:commandId         <CommandDetailPage>

  -- Creator routes --
  /publish                    <PublishPage>
  /my-packages                <MyPackagesPage>
  /analytics                  <AnalyticsPage>

  -- Workspace routes --
  /workspace/:workspaceId               <WorkspaceDetailPage>
  /workspace/:workspaceId/apps          <WorkspaceAppsPage>
  /workspace/page                       <WorkspacePage>
  /workspace/:workspaceId/chat          <WorkspaceChatPage>
  /workspace/:workspaceId/kanban        <WorkspaceKanbanPage>
  /workspace/:workspaceId/files         <WorkspaceFilesPage>
  /workspace/:workspaceId/cron          <WorkspaceCronPage>
  /workspace/:workspaceId/ideas         <WorkspaceIdeasPage>
  /workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId        <AgentDetailPage>
  /workspace/:workspaceId/executor/:executorType <ExecutorDetailPage>
  /workspace/:workspaceId/page/*        <WorkspacePage>
  /workspace/:workspaceId/web           <WorkspaceWebPage>
  /workspace/:workspaceId/agent         <WorkspaceAgentsPage>
  /workspace/:workspaceId/agents        <WorkspaceAgentsPage>
  /workspace/:workspaceId/github        <WorkspaceGitHubPage>
  /workspace/:workspaceId/chat-monitor  <ChatMonitorPage>

-- Standalone routes (no AppLayout) --
/tray-popup                 <TrayPopupPage>
/onboarding                 <OnboardingPage>
```

---

### Legacy Redirects (inside `<AppLayout>`)

```
/providers       → /mcp-services/data-sources
/search-service  → /mcp-services/search-service
/logs            → /mcp-services/logs
/agents          → /mcp-services/dashboard
```

---

### Global Overlays (rendered outside BrowserRouter)

These are not routes but always-present global components:
- `<OverlayRoot />`
- `<ActionApprovalDialog />`
- `<PresentationActionProvider />`
